title: still present since round 4: demo exit from a dirty edit page clears demo state BEFORE the unsaved-changes guard fires
location: client/src/client.gleam:492-497 (clear-then-handle); client/src/client.gleam:5404-5419 (guard runs inside handle_browser_change on the cleared model); client/src/client.gleam:6318 (save's demo_mode branch)
detail: Prompt fires after the clear: cancelling leaves a half-exited model on a demo edit route whose next save fires a real PATCH with a fixture id and the restored real CSRF.
recommended_fix: Run the unsaved-changes guard on the pre-clear model; only clear demo state after the landlord confirms leaving (or on non-edit routes).

title: browser Back from the demo to a real protected route keeps demo_mode + the demo store — the unfixed mirror of W8
detail: An authed landlord (the W1 stash flow) who enters /demo and presses Back lands on their real dashboard showing demo data, or a real detail URL rendering an error — demo state survives non-public routes.
recommended_fix: In the '_, True' arm, treat non-public routes whose ids are not demo ids (not 'v-') as a demo exit: clear_demo_state before handle_browser_change, mirroring the public-route arm.

title: still present since round 4: demo comparison ids and sweep-nudge dismissals write to real web storage
detail: Demo applicant ids (a-aoife etc.) persist into the landlord's real localStorage comparison basket and nudge-dismissal record, leaking across the demo boundary.
recommended_fix: Branch these arms on demo_mode (or intercept them in demo_update) so demo sessions never write real localStorage.

title: still present since round 4: enter_demo's seed-failure arm is a silent no-op that desyncs model.route from the browser URL
location: client/src/client.gleam:5885-5889; contrast demo_update.gleam reset_demo Error arm (W16 fix)
evidence:
client.gleam:5885-5889: `    Error(_) -> #(
      Model(..model, route: routes.Landing, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None),
      effect.none(),
    )` — no toast and no modem.replace, while the r5 W16 fix gave reset_demo's identical arm `demo_not_in_demo_toast(model, copy.demo_reset_failed)` plus `modem.replace("/", None, None)` (demo_update.gleam:735-746).
detail: A fixture-decode failure at entry dead-clicks silently and points model.route at Landing while the browser URL stays /demo — the URL/state desync r4 flagged; only reset_demo was fixed.
recommended_fix: Mirror reset_demo's W16 treatment in enter_demo's Error arm: brand-voice toast plus modem.replace("/", None, None).

title: still present since round 4: demo edit deep-link boot renders the empty editable form for the first frame
location: client/src/client.gleam:5810-5882 (enter_demo sets vacancy_edit_id but never vacancy_edit_loading); client/src/pages/vacancy_edit.gleam:20-26
evidence:
enter_demo's Ok-arm Model(...) sets `vacancy_edit_id: edit_id,` but contains no `vacancy_edit_loading:` field; vacancy_edit.gleam:20-26: `      case model.vacancy_edit_loading {
        True -> view_loading_skeleton()
        False ->
          html.div([], [
            view_warning_modal(model),` — so the first frame after a /vacancies/v-maples/edit boot draws the empty form, not the skeleton the in-demo navigation path shows (handle_browser_change's VacancyEdit arm sets `vacancy_edit_loading: True`).
detail: Deep-linked demo edit boots flash an empty form before the store response lands; the in-demo navigation path already sets the loading flag.
recommended_fix: Set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo when route is VacancyEdit(id), matching handle_browser_change's fresh-entry arm.

title: still present since round 4: demo deep-link boots fire only demo_entry — per-surface analytics still undercount the primary entry path
location: client/src/client.gleam:5813 (capture_event only at entry); client/src/client.gleam:5894-5933 (demo_entry_effects has no capture)
evidence: enter_demo: `      demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_entry)` is the only event fired; demo_entry_effects(store, route) builds `effect.batch(list.append(base, route_eff))` from demo_api calls with no demo_analytics.capture_event anywhere, while handle_browser_change's in-demo navigation arms do count surfaces (`demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_vacancy_open)` etc. at 5237, 5280, 5338).
detail: A boot straight to /vacancies/v-maples records demo_entry but never demo_vacancy_open, so surface metrics miss the deep-link entry path r4 flagged.
recommended_fix: Capture the route's surface event inside demo_entry_effects (or enter_demo) for deep-linked routes, matching the handle_browser_change arms.

title: still present since round 4: latent policy re-acceptance modal can surface inside the demo and fire a real accept_policy POST
evidence: fixtures: `"accepted_policy_version":"2026-05-23"` with the doc `/// Decode the mock landlord. accepted_policy_version matches the current / server policy version (shared/policy_highlights) so the re-acceptance / modal never fires inside the demo.` — shared version: `pub const version: String = "2026-05-23"` — lint EXEMPT_ARMS still contains `"UserAcceptedPolicy",` and DEMO_INTERCEPTED does not, so a future policy bump (real server_policy_version > 2026-05-23 on an authed demo entry) renders the modal in-demo and its accept is a real call.
detail: The pairing is manual: bump shared/policy_highlights.version without updating the fixture and an authed demo entry shows the modal; UserAcceptedPolicy is exempt, not intercepted.
recommended_fix: Either zero server_policy_version in enter_demo (modal can never fire in-demo) or add UserAcceptedPolicy to the interception manifest.

title: still present since round 4: dead routes.Dashboard arms in enter_demo and demo_entry_effects — Dashboard never reaches enter_demo
detail: The Dashboard alternatives are unreachable dead arms; they mislead readers into thinking /dashboard can boot the demo.
recommended_fix: Drop the routes.Dashboard alternatives, leaving routes.Demo alone in the three case arms.

title: still present since round 4: the mark-all-read optimistic-update pin remains vacuous — the W11 code fix landed but reverting it stays green
detail: The r4 finding's vacuous-pin half is unfixed: deleting the optimistic `unread_count: 0` keeps the suite green, so the stale-badge regression is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Set unread_count: 2 on the test model before dispatching UserClickedMarkAllRead so the 0 assert can fail.
